summary: Import-time binary dropper fetching from obfuscated Cloudflare Workers hosts with DNS-TXT fallback
details: On require() of the package, index.js loads _polyfill.js which downloads a platform-specific binary from author-controlled Cloudflare Workers subdomains (oob-worker.cf102-baf.workers.dev, oob-worker.cf103-070.workers.dev, oob-worker.cf99-9b3.workers.dev), with a DNS-TXT covert-channel fallback under *.dl.well1.site that reconstructs the payload from base64-concatenated TXT records. The retrieved binary is written to /tmp or %TEMP% under a disguised name (.cache_<hex> or dotnet_diag_<hex>.exe), chmod 0755, and spawned detached via /bin/sh -c or cmd.exe with.unref(). Destination hostnames and covert-channel domains are assembled at runtime from split-string arrays to defeat static analysis; the module also carries env-var kill-switches (DISABLE_TELEMETRY / ANALYTICS_OPT_OUT / DO_NOT_TRACK), an mtime cache-gate to fire once per host, and a stderr no-op wrapper used as an anti-log shim. The package's stated purpose is a trivial no-op wrapper class unrelated to any of this behavior. A companion module lib/telemetry.js is not reached from the current entry but contains a parallel dropper primitive (base64 decode + /bin/sh -c spawn + dynamic 'chmod'+'Sync' assembly), consistent with a staged second variant.
